rules.message: Review whether this internal development link belongs in the public output. Preserve useful provenance upstream.
Review this known internal resource reference. It may be intentional compatibility metadata, not an active public dependency.
Review ownership, pinning, and public availability of this Git dependency. An unlisted owner is not necessarily personal or private.
Review whether this known experimental/private-model reference is intended for public use. No network or access check was performed.
Review internal development provenance in public text; this is not a request to remove code directives, attribution, or licenses.
Review whether release-stage wording is still accurate. Valid release notes and support limitations may be retained.
